author: pereanub
title: NPU Models Tests fail installing TF Models tests requirements, unrelated to NPU mutex fix PR
signature: TensorFlow Models tests requirements pip install failure, unrelated to NPU code change|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: NPU Models Tests / 6010
failed_jobs.symptom: Step 'Install TF Models tests requirements' failed, causing 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (read_model)' to fail and downstream TF/PyTorch steps (groups C/D) to be skipped; PyTorch groups A/B and JAX/Flax tests in the same job passed.

key_errors: Job logs for the failing steps ('Install TF Models tests requirements', 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (read_model)') could not be retrieved: get_job_logs consistently returned tail-anchored content (JAX/PyTorch pass output, artifact upload) regardless of requested tail_lines (400 up to 1,000,000), and direct blob-storage/log-archive URLs were blocked by the sandbox network proxy (403 Forbidden).

Job environment showed PIP_INDEX_URL=http://pip-proxy.pip-proxy.svc.cluster.local/simple/ and PIP_TRUSTED_HOST=pip-proxy.pip-proxy.svc.cluster.local, consistent with an internal pip proxy dependency for the failing install step.
root_cause: The only PR change is src/plugins/intel_npu/src/utils/src/zero/zero_mem_pool.cpp (a mutex/object-lifetime fix), and all NPU-relevant tests in the same job (PyTorch groups A/B, JAX/Flax) passed. The failure occurred in a generic 'Install TF Models tests requirements' pip-install step feeding an NPU compile-only TF read_model check, not in any NPU runtime behavior touched by the PR. This pattern (unrelated TF dependency-install/test failures blocking unrelated PRs) has precedent in this repo's history, including a confirmed transient PyPI-index Network failure for the same requirements.txt family (grpcio) in a prior investigation. Exact error text for this run could not be captured due to log-retrieval tool limitations, so the specific sub-cause (proxy hiccup vs. package resolution vs. transient network blip) cannot be pinned down with high confidence.
reproduction_steps: N/A - could not reproduce without the captured pip error text; re-running the 'NPU Models Tests' job's 'Install TF Models tests requirements' step for run 33844291174 would show if it is transient.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'NPU Models Tests' job; PR's own code change (NPU mutex fix) is unaffected and unrelated to this failure.
If the failure recurs, capture the raw log for 'Install TF Models tests requirements' via the GitHub UI (tool-side log retrieval was blocked in this investigation) to confirm exact pip/proxy error.

Consider adding retry/backoff to pip install steps that depend on the internal pip-proxy service, mirroring the existing grpcio/PyPI mitigation recommendation from investigation 2026-06-29-21-12-18-000-28401943026.
prevention_strategies: Add resilience (retries, caching, or pre-baked images) for TF Models tests dependency installation so transient proxy/network blips do not block unrelated PRs merging through the queue.
historical_context: Two prior investigations recorded unrelated TensorFlow test/dependency failures blamed on non-TF PRs: 2026-06-29-21-12-18-000-28401943026 (pip install to resolve grpcio failed due to a truncated PyPI Simple API JSON response, category Network, High confidence) and a separate 'TensorFlow 2 Layer Tests TF FE fail unrelated to GPU plugin PR' entry (Flaky Test). This run fits the same broader theme of TF-related infra flakiness unrelated to the PR under test, though exact log evidence for this specific run was unobtainable.
